summary: The Agnes Macphail Award was established by the Borough of East York. It continues today as an annual event to recognize outstanding volunteers who live within the boundaries of the former borough. The Agnes Macphail Selection Committee met, as established in the selection process, on Thursday, January 16, 2020 to review the nominations received and to select this year's award recipients. The committee voted to nominate Paula Davies and Raymond White as the 2020 Agnes Macphail Award recipients. The award will be presented on March 29, 2020 at the Agnes Macphail Award Ceremony.
decided: City Council on February 26, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve Paula Davies and Raymond White as the recipients of the 2020 Agnes Macphail Award. 2. City Council request the City Clerk to determine an appropriate recognition of the 100th anniversary of the election of Agnes Macphail, the first woman elected to the House of Commons of Canada, and City Council request the City Clerk, in consultation with the Chief People Officer and the Executive Director, Social Development, Finance and Administration, to develop an enhanced and expanded Agnes Macphail Award consistent with other City of Toronto programs which recognize voluntary and community leadership.
